verdict.rationale: Square's own Terminal API overview documents checkout behavior on the terminal, such as collecting tips at checkout with a separate tip screen and custom amounts. Separately, the developer docs say payments can be processed on Square hardware. However, the pack never explicitly describes the server-driven flow of a backend creating checkout requests that push to a paired device. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of backend-initiated terminal checkout requests, device pairing, and status callbacks, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of a custom POS built on the Terminal API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom point-of-sale checkout that drives the terminal from my backend through a documented server-driven API

citations.quote: Tip money: Collect tips as money at checkout. Supports showing a separate tip input screen before getting a buyer's signature and allowing custom tip amounts.
Process payments on Square hardware or online using any Internet-connected device.
